notes.title: Update: Gamepad Vibration, Weapon Skill Improvements, Card List Popup
notes.content:
[p]Thank you for playing BATTLE SHADOW ARENA!
To provide a better gameplay experience, we have applied the following updates:[/p][p]Gamepad Vibration Added
The gamepad now vibrates when taking damage or using Battle Cards during combat.[/p][p]Weapon Active Skill Improvements
Several weapon active skills have been adjusted to make it easier to hit enemies.[/p][list][*][p]Dual Blades: Wind 10, 11, 12 / Earth 11[/p][/*][*][p]Spear: Water 8, 10, 11 / Wind 6, 10 / Earth 10 / Fire 10, 12[/p][/*][*][p]Greatsword: Water 10, 12 / Wind 3, 5, 10, 11, 12 / Earth 5, 6, 8, 10, 11 / Fire 3, 4, 6, 8, 10[/p][/*][/list][p]Battle Card List Popup
A popup UI has been added that allows you to view the [b]entire[/b] Battle Card list after combat in the card selection map.[/p][p]We will continue to do our best to deliver a more complete game.
Thank you sincerely for playing![/p]

tags.balance_change: Several weapon active skills have been adjusted to make it easier to hit enemies.

notes.title: Update: New Practice Map, Performance Optimization, and Growth Improvements
notes.content:
[p]Thank you for playing BATTLE SHADOW ARENA!
We’ve applied the following updates to provide a better gameplay experience.[/p][list][*][p]Practice Map Added
A dedicated practice map has been added to help new players learn the controls.
(Accessible from the Battle menu)[/p][/*][*][p]In-Combat Guide Display Added
You can now view the control guide from the pause menu during battle.[/p][/*][*][p]Skill Effect Optimization
Some skill effects that were causing frame drops have been optimized to improve performance.[/p][/*][*][p]Battle Menu UI Update
Improved controller navigation responsiveness and revised the stage reset text to be more intuitive.[/p][/*][*][p]Stat Reset Cost Greatly Reduced
To encourage experimenting with various builds, the stat reset cost has been reduced from 20% to 3%.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Healing Card Speed
The usage speed of healing-type battle cards has been increased, making recovery easier.[/p][/*][/list][p]We’ll continue working hard to deliver a more polished and enjoyable experience.
Thank you again for playing![/p]

notes.title: Update: AI Improvements, Balance Adjustments, and Effect Tweaks
notes.content:
[p]Thank you for playing BATTLE SHADOW ARENA![/p][p]To provide a fairer and more immersive combat experience, we've applied the following balance and system updates:[/p][list][*][p]Adjusted late-game boss attack tempo to allow more counterattack opportunities[/p][/*][*][p]Significantly reduced enemy stat scaling based on stage and level[/p][p](applies from stage 2-2 after resetting the stage)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where some card skills were dealing excessively high damage[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked the brightness of certain skill effects to reduce visual fatigue[/p][/*][/list][p]We’ll continue improving the gameplay experience.
Thank you for your feedback and support![/p]

tags.balance_change: Adjusted late-game boss attack tempo to allow more counterattack opportunities
Significantly reduced enemy stat scaling based on stage and level

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where some card skills were dealing excessively high damage

notes.title: Demo Update: UI Improvements, Localization Fixes & Lighting Enhancements
notes.content:
Thank you for playing the BATTLE SHADOW ARENA demo!

We've released a small update focused on improving clarity and visibility:

* Improved visibility of action button guide in the tutorial screen
* Corrected some unnatural translations for smoother localization
* Enhanced overall lighting in the underground map to improve visibility and atmosphere

Thank you for all your support and feedback!

tags.feature: Improved visibility of action button guide in the tutorial screen

tags.bug: Corrected some unnatural translations for smoother localization

tags.feature: Enhanced overall lighting in the underground map to improve visibility and atmosphere

notes.title: Demo Update: Combat Sound, Tooltips, UI Fixes
notes.content:
Thank you for playing the BATTLE SHADOW ARENA demo!

We've released a small update to improve the gameplay experience:

- Fixed gamepad focus issue in the Active Skill menu  
- Added tooltip in the Battle menu to display selected active/passive skills  
- Adjusted combat sound volume  
- Renamed some menu labels

Thank you for all the feedback and support.

tags.bug: - Fixed gamepad focus issue in the Active Skill menu

tags.feature: - Added tooltip in the Battle menu to display selected active/passive skills
